WITH local_schools AS (
    SELECT 
        s.`School`,
        s.`DOCType`,
        f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS diff

    JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode

WITH ranked_virtual AS (
    SELECT
        s.School,
        s.County,
        sc.AvgScrRead,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY sc.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rn
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'Y'
      AND sc.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School
FROM ranked_virtual
WHERE rn <= 5;

SELECT f.`Educational Option Type`
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH school_avg AS (
    SELECT
        s.cds,
        s.AvgScrMath,
        sc.County,
        (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) / 3.0 AS avg_all_subjects
    FROM satscores AS s
    JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
)
SELECT
    AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
    County AS county
FROM school_avg
ORDER BY avg_all_subjects ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite AS AverageWritingScore, sch.City
FROM satscores AS s
JOIN schools AS sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM satscores)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, sat.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Ulrich')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Ricci' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Ulrich');

SELECT
  f.`School Name`,
  f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment
FROM frpm f
WHERE f.`School Type` = 'State Special School'
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode) / 12.0 AS monthly_average_schools_opened
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND f.`District Type` = 'Elementary School District'
  AND strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) = '1980';

WITH unified_orange AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode) AS cnt
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f.`County Name` = 'Orange'
      AND f.`District Type` = 'Unified'
),
elementary AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CDSCode) AS cnt
    FROM frpm f
    WHERE f.`District Type` = 'Elementary'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN e.cnt = 0 THEN NULL 
        ELSE u.cnt * 1.0 / e.cnt 
    END AS ratio
FROM unified_orange u, elementary e;

WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS closed_cnt
    FROM schools
    WHERE ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY County
),
top_county AS (
    SELECT County
    FROM closed_counts
    ORDER BY closed_cnt DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.County,
       s.School,
       s.ClosedDate
FROM schools s
JOIN top_county tc ON s.County = tc.County
WHERE s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s.School;

WITH k8_schools AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        City,
        Magnet,
        GSoffered
    FROM schools
    WHERE GSoffered = 'K-8'
),
magnet_k8 AS (
    SELECT CDSCode, City
    FROM k8_schools
    WHERE Magnet = 1
),
provision_status AS (
    SELECT
        m.CDSCode,
        f.`NSLP Provision Status`
    FROM magnet_k8 m
    JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = m.CDSCode
),
magnet_multiple_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS magnet_multiple_count
    FROM provision_status
    WHERE `NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple'
),
city_counts AS (
    SELECT
        City,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM k8_schools
    GROUP BY City
),
total_cities AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT City) AS total_cities
    FROM k8_schools
)
SELECT
    c.City,
    c.school_count,
    t.total_cities,
    m.magnet_multiple_count
FROM city_counts c
CROSS JOIN total_cities t
CROSS JOIN magnet_multiple_count m
ORDER BY c.City;

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName1) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName2) <> ''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
    WHERE AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT first_name
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 2
),
name_district AS (
    SELECT a.first_name, a.District, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names a
    JOIN top_names t ON a.first_name = t.first_name
    GROUP BY a.first_name, a.District
),
top_district AS (
    SELECT first_name, District,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY first_name ORDER BY cnt DESC) AS rn
    FROM name_district
)
SELECT first_name AS FirstName, District
FROM top_district
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY FirstName;

      AND s.District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
      AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
      AND f.`School Type` IN ('Intermediate/Middle', 'Unified')
)
SELECT email
FROM (
    SELECT AdmEmail1 AS email FROM filtered_schools WHERE AdmEmail1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail1 <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT AdmEmail2 FROM filtered_schools WHERE AdmEmail2 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail2 <> ''
    UNION
    SELECT AdmEmail3 FROM filtered_schools WHERE AdmEmail3 IS NOT NULL AND AdmEmail3 <> ''
) AS all_emails
WHERE email LIKE '%@%.%';

SELECT s.School, s.AdmEmail1
FROM satscores AS sa
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sa.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'East Bohemia'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM disp dp
      JOIN card c ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
      JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
      WHERE dp.account_id = a.account_id
        AND c.issued > t.date
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS eligible_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
    ELSE '1996'
  END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS district_count
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'female'
  AND d.A8 > 6000
  AND d.A8 < 10000;

WITH male_clients AS (
    SELECT c.client_id
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
      AND d.A3 = 'North Bohemia'
),
client_avg_salary AS (
    SELECT mc.client_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_salary
    FROM male_clients mc
    JOIN disp dp ON mc.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN trans t ON dp.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.k_symbol = 'salary'
    GROUP BY mc.client_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_customer_count
FROM client_avg_salary
WHERE avg_salary > 8000;

WITH
    max_trans_date AS (
        SELECT MAX(REPLACE(date, '/', '-')) AS max_date
        FROM trans
    ),
    female_clients AS (
        SELECT client_id, birth_date
        FROM client
        WHERE gender = 'F'
    ),
    oldest_female AS (
        SELECT fc.client_id
        FROM female_clients fc, max_trans_date m
        WHERE (julianday(m.max_date) - julianday(REPLACE(fc.birth_date, '/', '-'))) / 365.25 = (
            SELECT MAX((julianday(m.max_date) - julianday(REPLACE(fc2.birth_date, '/', '-'))) / 365.25)
            FROM female_clients fc2, max_trans_date m2
        )
    ),
    client_avg_salary AS (
        SELECT c.client_id, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_salary
        FROM client c
        JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
        JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
        JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
        WHERE c.gender = 'F'
        GROUP BY c.client_id
    ),
    oldest_avg AS (
        SELECT cas.client_id, cas.avg_salary
        FROM client_avg_salary cas
        JOIN oldest_female ofc ON ofc.client_id = cas.client_id
    ),
    min_avg AS (
        SELECT MIN(avg_salary) AS min_avg_salary
        FROM oldest_avg
    ),
    max_avg_all_female AS (
        SELECT MAX(avg_salary) AS max_avg_salary
        FROM client_avg_salary
    ),
    salary_gap AS (
        SELECT (max_avg_salary - min_avg_salary) AS gap
        FROM max_avg_all_female, min_avg
    )
SELECT a.account_id, sg.gap
FROM oldest_avg oa
JOIN min_avg ma ON oa.avg_salary = ma.min_avg_salary
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = oa.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
CROSS JOIN salary_gap sg;

WITH ref AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS max_date FROM trans
),
client_age AS (
    SELECT 
        c.client_id,
        d.A10 AS salary,
        (julianday((SELECT max_date FROM ref)) - julianday(c.birth_date)) / 365.25 AS age
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
),
youngest AS (
    SELECT MIN(age) AS min_age FROM client_age
),
youngest_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id, salary, age
    FROM client_age, youngest
    WHERE age = min_age
),
max_salary AS (
    SELECT MAX(salary) AS max_sal FROM youngest_clients
),
target_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id
    FROM youngest_clients, max_salary
    WHERE salary = max_sal
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM target_clients tc
JOIN disp d ON tc.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS owner_weekly_customers
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND a.frequency = 'weekly';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cr ON d.disp_id = cr.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'Disponent'
  AND date(cr.issued) > date(t.date);

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT l.account_id, l.amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE l.status = 'approved'
      AND strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
      AND a.frequency = 'weekly'
)
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM filtered
WHERE amount = (SELECT MIN(amount) FROM filtered);

WITH qualifying AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           l.amount
    FROM account a
    JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration > 12
      AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
)
SELECT account_id
FROM qualifying
WHERE amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM qualifying);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_customers_count
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

WITH earliest_1995 AS (
    SELECT MIN(date) AS min_date
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
)
SELECT DISTINCT account_id
FROM trans
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
  AND date = (SELECT min_date FROM earliest_1995);

WITH latest_balance AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           balance,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY date DESC) AS rn
    FROM trans
)
SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN latest_balance lb ON a.account_id = lb.account_id
WHERE a.date < '1997-01-01'
  AND lb.rn = 1
  AND lb.balance > 3000;

SELECT c.client_id
FROM card AS ca
JOIN disp AS d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE ca.issued = '1994-03-03';

SELECT a.date
FROM account a
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 840
  AND strftime('%Y-%m-%d', t.date) = '1998-10-14';

SELECT a.district_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE date(l.date) = '1994-08-25';

SELECT MAX(t.amount) AS biggest_amount
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

WITH top_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A10 DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
accounts_in_top AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM account
    WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM top_district)
),
clients_in_top AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM disp d
    JOIN accounts_in_top a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
)
SELECT gender
FROM clients_in_top
ORDER BY date(REPLACE(birth_date, '/', '-')) ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH max_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan)
    LIMIT 1
),
client_account AS (
    SELECT a.account_id,
           a.date AS open_date,
           d.client_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN max_loan ml ON a.account_id = ml.account_id
    JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
    LIMIT 1
),
first_txn AS (
    SELECT t.amount
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_account ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE t.date > ca.open_date
    ORDER BY t.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT amount AS first_transaction_amount
FROM first_txn;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS women_clients_count
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A2 = 'Jesenik'
  AND c.gender = 'WOMAN';

SELECT d.disp_id
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t.amount = 5100
  AND t.date = '1998-09-02';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Litomerice'
  AND strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1996';

SELECT d.A2 AS district
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'female'
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29';

SELECT c.birth_date
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832
  AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp dsp ON a.account_id = dsp.account_id
JOIN client c ON dsp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A2 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_district AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'South Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS male_percentage
FROM client
WHERE district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM target_district);

WITH first_loan AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE date(REPLACE(l.date, '/', '-')) = date('1993-07-05')
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
client_account AS (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN first_loan fl ON d.account_id = fl.account_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_start AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_account ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE date(REPLACE(t.date, '/', '-')) <= date('1993-03-22')
    ORDER BY date(REPLACE(t.date, '/', '-')) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_end AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN client_account ca ON t.account_id = ca.account_id
    WHERE date(REPLACE(t.date, '/', '-')) <= date('1998-12-27')
    ORDER BY date(REPLACE(t.date, '/', '-')) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN bs.balance = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (be.balance - bs.balance) * 1.0 / bs.balance
    END AS increase_rate
FROM bal_start bs, bal_end be;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) / 
        NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0), 
        2
    ) AS percentage_fully_paid
FROM loan;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * 
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) 
         FROM loan 
         WHERE amount < 100000 
           AND status = 'C')
        /
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) 
         FROM loan 
         WHERE amount < 100000)
    , 2) AS percentage_running_no_issue;

WITH accounts_1993 AS (
    SELECT account_id, district_id
    FROM account
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1993'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS district_region
FROM accounts_1993 a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.issued > t.date;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND a.date >= '1995-01-01'
  AND a.date <= '2000-12-31';

SELECT a.account_id, a.date
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Prachatice';

SELECT d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    d.A2 AS district,
    d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000
GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3;

SELECT l.loan_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A10 AS average_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.duration = 60;

WITH running_loans AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A10 AS unemp_1995,
        d.A11 AS unemp_1996
    FROM loan l
    JOIN account a      ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN disp dp        ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
    JOIN client c       ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
    JOIN district d     ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE l.status = 'B'          -- loan contract still running
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    CASE
        WHEN unemp_1995 IS NULL OR unemp_1995 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(((unemp_1996 - unemp_1995) * 100.0) / unemp_1995, 2)
    END AS unemployment_rate_increment_pct
FROM running_loans
GROUP BY district_name, unemp_1995, unemp_1996
ORDER BY district_name;

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 
        2
    ) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993';

SELECT 
    a.district_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_account_holders
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'female'
GROUP BY a.district_id
ORDER BY female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

WITH jan_withdrawals AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        t.amount
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND t.date <  '1996-02-01'
      AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
      AND t.type <> 'credit card'
)
SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(jw.amount) AS total_withdrawal_amount
FROM jan_withdrawals jw
JOIN account a ON jw.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawal_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS no_credit_card_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A2 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM card cr
      JOIN disp d2 ON cr.disp_id = d2.disp_id
      WHERE d2.client_id = c.client_id
  );

SELECT d.A2 AS district
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'active'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'Male';

SELECT 
    d.A3 AS branch_location,
    d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
WHERE d.A12 = (
    SELECT MAX(d2.A12)
    FROM district d2
    WHERE d2.A12 IS NOT NULL
)
AND d.A12 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM account
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    ORDER BY A16 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS negative_balance_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'monthly'
  AND c.type = 'credit'
  AND t.type = 'withdrawal'
  AND t.date > c.issued
  AND t.balance < 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_loan_count
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND l.amount >= 250000
  AND a.frequency = 'monthly'
  AND l.status = 'A';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1
  AND l.status = 'C';

WITH district_events AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS event_count
  FROM loan l
  JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1995'
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT district_id,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY event_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM district_events
),
target_district AS (
  SELECT district_id
  FROM ranked_districts
  WHERE rnk = 2
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_client_count
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'Male'
  AND a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM target_district);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_level_owner_cards
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
WHERE card.type = 'gold'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT d.district_id, d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.amount > 10000
  AND t.date >= '1997-01-01'
  AND t.date <= '1997-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM `order` AS o
JOIN account AS a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE o.k_symbol = 'household payment'
  AND d.A2 = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'gold';

WITH credit_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE LOWER(c.type) = 'credit card'
)
SELECT AVG(monthly_total) AS avg_monthly_amount
FROM (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', t.date) AS year_month,
           SUM(t.amount) AS monthly_total
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM credit_accounts)
      AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '2021'
    GROUP BY year_month
);

WITH credit_trans AS (
    SELECT
        d.client_id,
        t.amount,
        t.date
    FROM trans t
    JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN card c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.type = 'credit card'
      AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
),
avg_amount AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_amt FROM credit_trans
)
SELECT DISTINCT ct.client_id
FROM credit_trans ct
CROSS JOIN avg_amount a
WHERE ct.amount < a.avg_amt;

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN card cr ON cr.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'female'
  AND cr.type = 'credit';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS female_accounts
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND dist.A3 = 'South Bohemia';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'Tabor'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan l
      WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
  );

SELECT DISTINCT a.frequency AS account_type
FROM account a
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.account_id IS NULL
  AND d.A10 > 8000
  AND d.A10 <= 9000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE d.A2 = 'North Bohemia'
  AND t.bank = 'AB';

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district_name
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'withdrawal' OR t.operation = 'withdrawal';

WITH districts_with_1997_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM account
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01'
),
district_1995_counts AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, COUNT(*) AS crime_count
    FROM trans t
    JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE t.date >= '1995-01-01' AND t.date <= '1995-12-31'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
)
SELECT AVG(dc.crime_count) AS average_crimes
FROM district_1995_counts dc
JOIN districts_with_1997_accounts d ON dc.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE dc.crime_count > 4000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id) AS classic_cards_eligible_for_loan
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN loan l ON d.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.type = 'classic';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_client_count
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'Gold' AND issued < '1998-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

    2

    FROM client c
    WHERE c.gender = 'female'
),
max_age AS (
    SELECT MAX(age) AS max_age FROM client_age
),
oldest_female AS (
    SELECT client_id FROM client_age
    WHERE age = (SELECT max_age FROM max_age)
),
account_loan_avg AS (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        AVG(l.amount) AS avg_loan
    FROM disp d
    JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id IN (SELECT client_id FROM oldest_female)
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
min_avg AS (
    SELECT MIN(avg_loan) AS min_avg_loan FROM account_loan_avg
)

WHERE avg_loan = (SELECT min_avg_loan FROM min_avg);

           a2.element AS elem2
    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
),
combo_counts AS (
    SELECT CASE 
               WHEN elem1 <= elem2 THEN elem1 || '-' || elem2
               ELSE elem2 || '-' || elem1
           END AS combo,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM bond_elements
    GROUP BY combo
),
max_cnt AS (
    SELECT MAX(cnt) AS max_cnt FROM combo_counts
),
total_bonds AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM bond
)
SELECT (max_cnt.max_cnt * 100.0) / total_bonds.total AS percentage

WITH total_heroes AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cnt
    FROM superhero
),
self_interest_heroes AS (
    SELECT s.id, s.publisher_id
    FROM superhero s
    JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
    WHERE a.alignment LIKE '%self-interest%' 
       OR a.alignment LIKE '%moral code%'
),
matching_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_cnt
    FROM self_interest_heroes
),
marvel_matching AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS marvel_cnt
    FROM self_interest_heroes h
    JOIN publisher p ON h.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * mc.match_cnt / t.total_cnt, 2) AS percentage_self_interest_or_moral_code,
    mm.marvel_cnt AS marvel_count
FROM matching_count mc
CROSS JOIN total_heroes t
CROSS JOIN marvel_matching mm;

WITH counts AS (

    FROM superhero s
    JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
    WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC', 'Marvel Comics')
    GROUP BY p.publisher_name
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT publisher_name FROM counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) AS publisher_with_more,
    (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM counts) - (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM counts) AS difference;

    ORDER BY date ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
speeds AS (
    SELECT
        CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM results WHERE raceId = 853 AND driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM driver_id)) AS REAL) AS speed_853,
        CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM next_race_id) AND driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM driver_id)) AS REAL) AS speed_next
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN speed_next IS NULL OR speed_next = 0 THEN NULL

    END AS percent_faster
FROM speeds;

WITH race AS (

    WHERE year = 2008
      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
total_laps AS (
    SELECT MAX(laps) AS max_laps
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race)
),
counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_drivers,
        SUM(CASE WHEN r.laps = tl.max_laps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_drivers
    FROM results r
    CROSS JOIN total_laps tl
    WHERE r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race)
)

champ AS (

      AND positionOrder = 1
),
last AS (
    SELECT milliseconds AS last_ms
    FROM results
    WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_id)
      AND positionOrder = (
          SELECT MAX(positionOrder)
          FROM results
          WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_id)
      )
)
SELECT ((last.last_ms - champ.champ_ms) * 100.0) / last.last_ms AS percentage_faster

    milliseconds
FROM driver_latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY raceDate DESC, lap DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.year
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.year
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL AND res.fastestLapSpeed != ''
ORDER BY CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT driverId
FROM lapTimes
WHERE lap = 1
GROUP BY driverId
ORDER BY MIN(milliseconds) ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH disqualified_status AS (
    SELECT statusId
    FROM status
    WHERE LOWER(status) = 'disqualified'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS disqualified_finishers
FROM results r
JOIN disqualified_status ds ON r.statusId = ds.statusId
WHERE r.raceId BETWEEN 50 AND 100;

SELECT 
    c.location,
    c.lat,
    c.lng,
    COUNT(r.raceId) AS times_held
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria'
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.location, c.lat, c.lng
ORDER BY times_held DESC;

SELECT r.round
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.raceId, r.round
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef,
       d.nationality,
       d.dob
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 23
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> '';

WITH youngest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT r.year,
       r.name,
       r.date,
       r.time
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE q.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM youngest_driver)
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS american_drivers_with_puncture
FROM results r
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE s.status = 'Puncture'
  AND d.nationality = 'American';

SELECT c.url
FROM constructors AS c
JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.url
ORDER BY SUM(cr.points) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN results r ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId
WHERE r.position = 1
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.url
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH french_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE name LIKE '%French Grand Prix%'
)
SELECT d.forename,
       d.surname,
       lt.time,
       lt.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN french_races fr ON lt.raceId = fr.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE lt.lap = 3
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.raceId, r.name, lt.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE lt.lap = 1
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH target_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2006
      AND name = 'United States Grand Prix'
),
top10_fastest AS (
    SELECT r.fastestLapTime
    FROM results r
    JOIN target_race tr ON r.raceId = tr.raceId
    WHERE r.positionOrder <= 10
      AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(
    CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, 1, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
    CAST(substr(fastestLapTime, instr(fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
) AS avg_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM top10_fastest;

WITH german_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname
    FROM drivers
    WHERE nationality = 'German'
      AND dob BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
),
driver_avg_pit AS (
    SELECT p.driverId,
           AVG(p.milliseconds) AS avg_pit_ms
    FROM pitStops p
    JOIN german_drivers gd ON p.driverId = gd.driverId
    GROUP BY p.driverId
)
SELECT d.driverId,
       d.forename,
       d.surname,
       da.avg_pit_ms
FROM driver_avg_pit da
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = da.driverId
ORDER BY da.avg_pit_ms ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.time
FROM races ra
JOIN results r ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008
  AND r.position = 1;

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, dob
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'Austrian'
  AND dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31';

SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS full_name, url, dob
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
  AND dob BETWEEN '1971-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
ORDER BY dob DESC;

WITH monaco_points AS (
    SELECT
        cr.constructorId,
        SUM(cr.points) AS total_points
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
      AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
    GROUP BY cr.constructorId
)
SELECT
    mp.total_points AS score,
    c.name,
    c.nationality
FROM monaco_points mp
JOIN constructors c ON mp.constructorId = c.constructorId
ORDER BY mp.total_points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(r.points) AS average_score
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix'
  AND d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton';

WITH race_counts AS (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS num_races
    FROM races
    WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT AVG(num_races) AS annual_average_races
FROM race_counts;

SELECT nationality
FROM drivers
GROUP BY nationality
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH driver_total_points AS (
    SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points
    FROM results
    GROUP BY driverId
),
ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT driverId,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rank
    FROM driver_total_points
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS victories
FROM results r
JOIN ranked_drivers rd ON r.driverId = rd.driverId
WHERE rd.rank = 91
  AND r.position = 1;

SELECT r.name
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.location || ', ' || c.country AS location
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
ORDER BY r.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.position = 1;

WITH youngest AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname, nationality
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
first_race AS (
    SELECT r.name AS race_name
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE res.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM youngest)
    ORDER BY r.date ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    y.forename || ' ' || y.surname AS full_name,
    y.nationality,
    fr.race_name
FROM youngest y, first_race fr;

WITH canadian_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE name LIKE '%Canadian Grand Prix%'
),
accident_counts AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(*) AS accident_count
    FROM results r
    JOIN canadian_races cr ON r.raceId = cr.raceId
    JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE s.status LIKE '%Accident%'
    GROUP BY r.driverId
)
SELECT accident_count
FROM accident_counts
ORDER BY accident_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH oldest_driver AS (
    SELECT driverId, forename, surname
    FROM drivers
    WHERE dob IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY dob ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    od.forename || ' ' || od.surname AS full_name,
    COUNT(r.resultId) AS wins
FROM oldest_driver od
LEFT JOIN results r ON r.driverId = od.driverId AND r.position = 1
GROUP BY od.driverId, od.forename, od.surname;

SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS longest_pit_stop_milliseconds
FROM pitStops;

SELECT time
FROM lapTimes
WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pitStops.duration, pitStops.milliseconds
FROM pitStops
JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY pitStops.milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2011
      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
driver AS (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE forename = 'Lewis'
      AND surname = 'Hamilton'
)
SELECT pitStops.lap
FROM pitStops
JOIN race ON pitStops.raceId = race.raceId
JOIN driver ON pitStops.driverId = driver.driverId;

SELECT 
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    p.duration AS pit_stop_duration
FROM pitStops p
JOIN races r ON p.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2011
  AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
ORDER BY driver_name, p.stop;

SELECT lt.time
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
       MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS shortest_lap_ms
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY shortest_lap_ms ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.round AS circuit_position
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND res.fastestLap IS NOT NULL;

SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS lap_record_milliseconds
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.circuitId IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT circuitId
    FROM races
    WHERE name LIKE '%Austrian%'
);

WITH italian_circuits AS (
    SELECT circuitId, name AS circuit_name
    FROM circuits
    WHERE country = 'Italy'
),
lap_records AS (
    SELECT
        c.circuit_name,
        ra.name AS race_name,
        ra.date AS race_date,
        d.forename,
        d.surname,
        lt.lap,
        lt.time,
        lt.milliseconds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.circuitId
            ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC, lt.lap ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM italian_circuits c
    JOIN races ra ON ra.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.raceId = ra.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
)
SELECT
    circuit_name,
    race_name,
    race_date,
    forename,
    surname,
    lap,
    time,
    milliseconds
FROM lap_records
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY circuit_name;

SELECT r.name
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Austrian%'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH austrian_circuit AS (
    SELECT circuitId
    FROM circuits
    WHERE name LIKE '%Austria%'
    LIMIT 1
),
austrian_races AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE circuitId = (SELECT circuitId FROM austrian_circuit)
),
fastest_lap_race AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.driverId
    FROM results r
    JOIN austrian_races ar ON r.raceId = ar.raceId
    WHERE r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY r.fastestLapTime ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT SUM(p.milliseconds) AS total_pit_stop_milliseconds
FROM pitStops p
JOIN fastest_lap_race flr
  ON p.raceId = flr.raceId
 AND p.driverId = flr.driverId;

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
GROUP BY c.circuitId
HAVING MIN(lt.time) = '1:29.488';

SELECT AVG(pitStops.milliseconds) AS average_pit_stop_ms
FROM pitStops
JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Lewis' AND drivers.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) AS avg_lap_time_ms
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Italy';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE potential = (SELECT MIN(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

WITH player_work_rates AS (
    SELECT
        player_api_id,
        MAX(CASE attacking_work_rate
                WHEN 'high' THEN 3
                WHEN 'medium' THEN 2
                WHEN 'low' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) AS att_wr,
        MAX(CASE defensive_work_rate
                WHEN 'high' THEN 3
                WHEN 'medium' THEN 2
                WHEN 'low' THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END) AS def_wr
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 65
    GROUP BY player_api_id
    HAVING att_wr > def_wr
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM player_work_rates;

WITH best_crossers AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(crossing) AS best_crossing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE crossing IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT player_api_id AS player_id
FROM best_crossers
ORDER BY best_crossing DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN `Match` m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season LIKE '2016%'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH home_losses AS (
    SELECT 
        m.home_team_api_id AS team_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS losses
    FROM `Match` m
    WHERE m.season LIKE '2016%'
    GROUP BY m.home_team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    t.team_long_name AS home_team,
    hl.losses
FROM home_losses hl
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = hl.team_id
ORDER BY hl.losses ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY SUM(pa.penalties) DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH scottish_prem AS (
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id,
           m.home_team_goal,
           m.away_team_goal
    FROM `Match` m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
    WHERE c.name = 'Scotland'
      AND l.name = 'Premier League'
      AND m.season LIKE '2010%'
)
SELECT t.team_long_name AS away_team,
       COUNT(*) AS wins
FROM scottish_prem sp
JOIN Team t ON sp.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE sp.away_team_goal > sp.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH team_speeds AS (
    SELECT 
        ta.team_api_id,
        MAX(ta.buildUpPlaySpeed) AS buildUpPlaySpeed
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    GROUP BY ta.team_api_id
)
SELECT 
    t.team_long_name,
    ts.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM team_speeds ts
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = ts.team_api_id
ORDER BY ts.buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

WITH draws AS (
    SELECT m.league_id, COUNT(*) AS draw_count
    FROM `Match` m
    WHERE m.season = '2016'
      AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal
    GROUP BY m.league_id
)
SELECT l.name
FROM draws d
JOIN League l ON l.id = d.league_id
ORDER BY d.draw_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        pa.player_api_id,
        pa.date,
        p.birthday
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
      AND date(REPLACE(pa.date, '/', '-')) BETWEEN date('2013-01-01') AND date('2015-12-31')
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(
        (julianday(date(REPLACE(date, '/', '-'))) - julianday(date(REPLACE(birthday, '/', '-')))) / 365.25
    AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM filtered;

SELECT l.name AS league_name, COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH avg_rating AS (
    SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
),
max_above AS (
    SELECT MAX(overall_rating) AS max_overall
    FROM Player_Attributes, avg_rating
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
      AND overall_rating > avg_rating.avg_overall
)
SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes, max_above
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating = max_above.max_overall;

WITH avg_pass AS (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing) AS avg_pass
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
),
team_latest AS (
    SELECT ta.team_api_id, ta.buildUpPlayPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    JOIN (
        SELECT team_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Team_Attributes
        WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
        GROUP BY team_api_id
    ) lm ON ta.team_api_id = lm.team_api_id AND ta.date = lm.max_date
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM team_latest tl
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = tl.team_api_id
JOIN avg_pass ap ON tl.buildUpPlayPassing > ap.avg_pass;

WITH latest_attr AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.preferred_foot
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) md ON pa.player_api_id = md.player_api_id AND pa.date = md.max_date
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN la.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS left_foot_percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN latest_attr la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992;

SELECT 
    l.name AS league_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(m.home_team_goal, 0) + COALESCE(m.away_team_goal, 0)) AS total_goals
FROM `Match` AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT p.player_name,
       AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) AS avg_heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY avg_heading_accuracy DESC
LIMIT 10;

WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT
        ta.team_api_id,
        ta.chanceCreationPassing
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'normal'
      AND strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2014'
),
avg_ccp AS (
    SELECT AVG(chanceCreationPassing) AS avg_ccp FROM filtered
)
SELECT
    t.team_long_name
FROM filtered f
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = f.team_api_id
CROSS JOIN avg_ccp a
WHERE f.chanceCreationPassing < a.avg_ccp
ORDER BY f.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

WITH league_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        m.league_id,
        AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS avg_home,
        AVG(m.away_team_goal) AS avg_away
    FROM `Match` m
    WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
    GROUP BY m.league_id
)
SELECT 
    l.name
FROM league_stats ls
JOIN League l ON l.id = ls.league_id
WHERE ls.avg_home > ls.avg_away;

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1970'
  AND strftime('%m', birthday) = '10';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag'
ORDER BY date(ta.date) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT pa.finishing
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND pa.date = '18/09/2014';

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas'
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND c.name = 'Scotland';

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.birthday = (SELECT MAX(birthday) FROM Player)
ORDER BY date(pa.date) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name, pa.potential
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
ORDER BY p.player_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight < 130
  AND pa.preferred_foot = 'left';

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky';

SELECT pa.defensive_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'David Wilson'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.birthday
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT L.name
FROM League L
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Netherlands';

SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS avg_home_goal
FROM `Match` AS m
JOIN Country AS c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland'
  AND m.season = '2010/2011';

WITH tallest AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
shortest AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, player_name
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY height ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_fin AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, AVG(pa.finishing) AS avg_finishing
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    WHERE pa.player_api_id IN (
        SELECT player_api_id FROM tallest
        UNION
        SELECT player_api_id FROM shortest
    )

  SELECT away_player_3, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_4, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_4 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_5, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_5 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_6, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_6 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_7, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_7 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_8, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_8 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_9, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_9 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_10, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_10 IS NOT NULL
  UNION
  SELECT away_player_11, country_id FROM `Match` WHERE away_player_11 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT c.name, AVG(p.weight) AS average_weight
FROM player_country pc
JOIN Player p ON pc.pid = p.player_api_id
JOIN Country c ON pc.country_id = c.id
WHERE p.weight IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY average_weight DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'slow';

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'safe';

WITH player_best_rating AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, MAX(overall_rating) AS best_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes
    GROUP BY player_api_id
)
SELECT player_name
FROM (
    SELECT p.player_name, pbr.best_rating
    FROM Player p
    JOIN player_best_rating pbr ON p.player_api_id = pbr.player_api_id
    WHERE p.height > 180
    ORDER BY pbr.best_rating DESC, p.player_name
    LIMIT 3
) AS top_players
ORDER BY player_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player
WHERE SUBSTR(player_name, 1, INSTR(player_name, ' ') - 1) = 'Aaron'
  AND date(birthday) > '1999-12-31';

WITH p6 AS (
    SELECT jumping
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE player_api_id = 6
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
p23 AS (
    SELECT jumping
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE player_api_id = 23
    ORDER BY date DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (p6.jumping - p23.jumping) AS difference
FROM p6, p23;

SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes pa
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'Right'
ORDER BY pa.potential ASC
LIMIT 5;

WITH left_players AS (
    SELECT player_api_id, crossing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
),
max_cross AS (
    SELECT MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing
    FROM left_players
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM left_players, max_cross
WHERE crossing = max_cross.max_crossing;

WITH total_players AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS total
    FROM Player_Attributes
),
qualified_players AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS qualified
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE strength > 80 AND stamina > 80
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * qualified_players.qualified / total_players.total, 2) AS percentage
FROM total_players, qualified_players;

SELECT c.name
FROM League l
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE l.name LIKE '%Ekstraklasa%';

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM `Match` AS m
JOIN League AS l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgian Jupiler League'
  AND m.date = '2008-09-24';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin'
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name LIKE '%Cercle Brugge%'
ORDER BY ta.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS games_played
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND l.name = 'Serie A'
  AND c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT MAX(m.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Netherlands' AND l.name = 'Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
WHERE pa.player_api_id = (
    SELECT player_api_id
    FROM Player
    ORDER BY weight DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT l.name, COUNT(*) AS num_games
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM `Match` m
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(m.away_team_goal, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.strength DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_attr AS (
    SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.strength
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) lm ON pa.player_api_id = lm.player_api_id AND pa.date = lm.max_date
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN la.strength > 70 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN latest_attr la ON p.player_api_id = la.player_api_id
WHERE p.height < 180;

WITH male_admission AS (
  SELECT
    Admission,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM Patient
  WHERE UPPER(SEX) IN ('MALE', 'M')
  GROUP BY Admission
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(Admission) LIKE '%INPATIENT%' THEN cnt END), 0) AS in_patient_male,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(Admission) LIKE '%OUTPATIENT%' THEN cnt END), 0) AS out_patient_male
  FROM male_admission
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN in_patient_male > out_patient_male THEN 'In-patient'
    WHEN out_patient_male > in_patient_male THEN 'Out-patient'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS more_male,
  ROUND(
    ABS(in_patient_male - out_patient_male) * 100.0 / NULLIF(in_patient_male + out_patient_male, 0),
    2
  ) AS deviation_percentage
FROM counts;

SELECT 
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' AND Birthday > '1930-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS percentage
FROM Patient;

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'Inpatient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';

WITH sle_followed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
    FROM Patient p
    INNER JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'Outpatient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = 'Inpatient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outpatient_to_inpatient_ratio
FROM sle_followed;

SELECT p.Diagnosis AS Disease, l.Date AS LaboratoryDate
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = 30609;

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 163109;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH IS NOT NULL AND (l.LDH < 100 OR l.LDH > 200);

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS Age
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND LOWER(e.LAC) = 'positive'
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND l.`T-CHO` > 200;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.ALB < 3.5
);

WITH female_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX IN ('F', 'Female')
),
abnormal_tp_females AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN female_patients fp ON l.ID = fp.ID
    WHERE l.TP IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.TP < 6.0 OR l.TP > 8.3)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal_tp_females), 0) 
        / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM female_patients), 0), 
    2) AS percentage_female_abnormal_tp;

WITH ref AS (
    SELECT MAX(`Examination Date`) AS max_date
    FROM Examination
),
eligible_patients AS (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    CROSS JOIN ref
    WHERE p.Admission = 'Inpatient'
      AND (julianday(ref.max_date) - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 >= 50
)
SELECT AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_aCL_IgG
FROM Examination e
JOIN eligible_patients ep ON e.ID = ep.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS female_patients_count
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) = '1997'
  AND E.`Examination Date` = P.`First Date`;

WITH max_thrombosis AS (
    SELECT MAX(Thrombosis) AS max_thromb
    FROM Examination
    WHERE strftime('%Y', `Examination Date`) = '1997'
),
serious_cases AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination, max_thrombosis
    WHERE strftime('%Y', `Examination Date`) = '1997'
      AND Thrombosis = max_thrombosis.max_thromb
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS women_count
FROM serious_cases sc
JOIN Patient p ON sc.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F';

WITH PatientsWithNormalTG AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Birthday
    FROM Patient P
    JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
    WHERE L.TG IS NOT NULL AND L.TG > 0 AND L.TG < 150
)
SELECT (julianday(MAX(Birthday)) - julianday(MIN(Birthday))) / 365.25 AS age_gap
FROM PatientsWithNormalTG;

SELECT e.Symptoms, e.Diagnosis
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = (
    SELECT MAX(p2.Birthday)
    FROM Patient p2
    JOIN Examination e2 ON p2.ID = e2.ID
)
LIMIT 1;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month) AS (
    SELECT 1
    UNION ALL
    SELECT month + 1 FROM months WHERE month < 12
),
male_lab AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', l.Date) AS ym, l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
    WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
      AND date(l.Date) BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
),
monthly_counts AS (
    SELECT m.month,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ml.ID) AS cnt
    FROM months m
    LEFT JOIN male_lab ml
           ON ml.ym = printf('1998-%02d', m.month)
    GROUP BY m.month
)
SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_male_patients_per_month
FROM monthly_counts;

WITH sjs_patients AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        CAST(
            (julianday(REPLACE(`First Date`, '/', '-')) - julianday(REPLACE(Birthday, '/', '-'))) / 365.25
        AS INTEGER) AS AgeAtArrival
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SJS'
),
oldest_sjs AS (
    SELECT ID, AgeAtArrival
    FROM sjs_patients
    ORDER BY AgeAtArrival DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    MAX(REPLACE(Date, '/', '-')) AS LabCompletionDate,
    oldest_sjs.AgeAtArrival AS AgeAtArrival
FROM oldest_sjs
JOIN Laboratory ON Laboratory.ID = oldest_sjs.ID;

WITH abnormal_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL
      AND (
          (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 7.0)
          OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.0)
      )
)
SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM abnormal_patients;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM (
    SELECT p.ID
    FROM Patient p
    JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID
    HAVING MIN(date(e.`Examination Date`)) >= date(p.`First Date`, '+1 year')
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS underage_patient_count
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1993-12-31'
  AND e.`Examination Date` < date(p.Birthday, '+18 years');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_patients_elevated_tbil
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'Male'
  AND l.`T-BIL` > 1.2;

SELECT p.Diagnosis, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE date(l.Date) BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY patient_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG((julianday('1999-12-31') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25) AS average_age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', l.Date) = '1991-10';

WITH highest_hgb AS (
    SELECT e.ID, e.`Examination Date`, l.HGB, e.Diagnosis
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN Laboratory l 
        ON e.ID = l.ID 
        AND e.`Examination Date` = l.Date
    WHERE l.HGB IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY l.HGB DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', h.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
     - (strftime('%m-%d', h.`Examination Date`) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))) AS Age,
    h.Diagnosis
FROM highest_hgb h
JOIN Patient p ON h.ID = p.ID;

SELECT `ANA`
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = 3605340
  AND `Examination Date` = '1996/12/2';

SELECT CASE 
         WHEN `T-CHO` < 200 THEN 'Yes' 
         ELSE 'No' 
       END AS `Normal Level`
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464 
  AND Date = '1995-9-4';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY e.`Examination Date` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.`aCL IgG`, e.`aCL IgM`, e.`aCL IgA`
FROM Examination e
WHERE e.ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND `Examination Date` = '1994-02-19'
    LIMIT 1
)
AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date = '1992-06-12' AND l.GPT = 9;

SELECT 
    (CAST(strftime('%Y', L.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) -
     CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', L.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', P.Birthday) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Age
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.UA = 8.4
  AND L.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_lab_tests_1995
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE `First Date` = '1991-06-13'
      AND Diagnosis = 'SJS'
    LIMIT 1
)
  AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1995';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27' AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959/3/1'
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1993/9/27';

WITH patient AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18'
),
nov AS (
    SELECT `T-CHO` AS nov_cho
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM patient)
      AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1981'
      AND strftime('%m', Date) = '11'
),
dec AS (
    SELECT `T-CHO` AS dec_cho
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ID = (SELECT ID FROM patient)
      AND strftime('%Y', Date) = '1981'
      AND strftime('%m', Date) = '12'
)
SELECT (nov.nov_cho - dec.dec_cho) * 1.0 / nov.nov_cho AS decrease_rate
FROM nov, dec;

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'Behcet''s'
  AND `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON e.ID = l.ID
 AND e.`Examination Date` = l.Date
WHERE e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND l.GPT > 30
  AND l.ALB < 4
ORDER BY e.ID;

SELECT ID, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1964'
  AND Admission IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ID;

WITH avg_igm AS (
    SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) AS avg_val
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT E.ID) AS number_of_patients
FROM Examination E
CROSS JOIN avg_igm
WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2
  AND E.`ANA Pattern` = 'S'
  AND E.`aCL IgM` IS NOT NULL
  AND E.`aCL IgM` > 1.2 * avg_igm.avg_val;

WITH protein_normal_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE `U-PRO` = 'negative'
),
ua_below_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE UA < 3.0
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 
        ELSE 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ub.ID IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) 
    END AS percentage
FROM protein_normal_patients pn
LEFT JOIN ua_below_patients ub ON pn.ID = ub.ID;

SELECT 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', p.`First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Admission
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Admission LIKE '%outpatient%'
  AND strftime('%Y-%m', l.Date) = '1991-10'
  AND l.`T-BIL` BETWEEN 0.2 AND 1.2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS women_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Birthday BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1989-12-31'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
        AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'
  );

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND l.CRP = '2+'
  AND l.CRE = 1
  AND l.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(l.ALB) AS AverageAlbumin
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.PLT > 400;

SELECT Symptoms, COUNT(*) AS frequency
FROM Examination
WHERE UPPER(Diagnosis) LIKE '%SLE%' AND Symptoms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY frequency DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory L
WHERE L.Date >= '1997-01-01' 
  AND L.Date <= '1997-12-31'
  AND L.TP IS NOT NULL
  AND (L.TP < 6.0 OR L.TP > 8.3);

WITH thrombocytopenia_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE PLT < 150
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN LOWER(p.Diagnosis) = 'sle' THEN t.ID END) AS REAL) 
    / COUNT(DISTINCT t.ID) AS proportion_sle
FROM thrombocytopenia_patients t
LEFT JOIN Patient p ON t.ID = p.ID;

SELECT 
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_female
FROM Patient
WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS male_behcet_no_hospital_stay
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND e.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'
  AND e.Diagnosis = 'Behcet disease'
  AND (p.Admission IS NULL OR p.Admission = 'No');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patients_with_low_wbc
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT 
  CAST(julianday(MIN(e.`Examination Date`)) - julianday(p.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) AS days_until_evaluation
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT 
    l.`Date`,
    l.UA,
    CASE
        WHEN l.UA BETWEEN 2.5 AND 7.5 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Uric_Acid_Status
FROM Laboratory l
WHERE l.ID = 57266;

SELECT `Date`
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 48473
  AND GOT > 40;

SELECT DISTINCT p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1994'
  AND l.GOT BETWEEN 10 AND 40;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE UPPER(p.SEX) IN ('M', 'MALE')
  AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL
  AND l.GPT > 40;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT > 40
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    CAST((julianday(l.Date) - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH BETWEEN 100 AND 300;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Admission
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALP BETWEEN 20 AND 140;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    l.ALP,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALP BETWEEN 30 AND 120 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS ALP_within_normal_range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01'
ORDER BY l.Date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.ID = P.ID
      AND L.TP < 6.0
);

SELECT P.ID,
       L.TP,
       CASE
           WHEN L.TP > 8.0 THEN L.TP - 8.0
           WHEN L.TP < 6.0 THEN 6.0 - L.TP
       END AS deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND (L.TP > 8.0 OR L.TP < 6.0);

SELECT P.*
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS L
      WHERE L.ID = P.ID
        AND (L.ALB < 3.5 OR L.ALB > 5.0)
  )
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.Birthday,
    l.ALB,
    CASE 
        WHEN l.ALB IS NULL THEN 'No albumin data'
        WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.0 THEN 'Within normal range'
        ELSE 'Outside normal range'
    END AS Albumin_Status
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

WITH female_patients AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'F'
),
abnormal_female AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN female_patients fp ON l.ID = fp.ID
    WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL
      AND (l.UA < 2.4 OR l.UA > 6.0)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal_female) 
        / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM female_patients), 0), 
    2) AS percentage_abnormal_ua;

WITH latest_lab AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.UA
    FROM Laboratory l
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) ld ON l.ID = ld.ID AND l.Date = ld.latest_date
)
SELECT AVG(latest_lab.UA) AS average_ua
FROM latest_lab
WHERE latest_lab.UA BETWEEN 3 AND 7;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN BETWEEN 19 AND 20;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday

FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'Male'

  AND (l.CRE < 0.7 OR l.CRE > 1.3);

WITH abnormal_patients AS (

  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.CRE IS NOT NULL AND (l.CRE < 0.6 OR l.CRE > 1.2)
)
SELECT CASE
  WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >
       SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
  THEN 'True' ELSE 'False'
END AS result
FROM abnormal_patients;

male_high_cholesterol AS (

WITH ref AS (
    SELECT MAX(`Date`) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT 
    p.ID,
    p.SEX,
    CAST((julianday(r.max_date) - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN ref r
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND (l.GLU < 70 OR l.GLU > 110)          -- glucose outside normal range
      AND l.`T-CHO` <= 200                     -- total cholesterol within normal range
);

SELECT p.ID, l.GLU
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

WITH max_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(Date) AS ref_date FROM Laboratory
),
abnormal_wbc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE WBC IS NOT NULL AND (WBC < 4.0 OR WBC > 11.0)
)
SELECT
  p.ID,
  p.SEX,
  p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN abnormal_wbc aw ON p.ID = aw.ID
CROSS JOIN max_date md
ORDER BY
  p.SEX,
  ((CAST(strftime('%Y', md.ref_date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) -
   (CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', md.ref_date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) ASC;

SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.Diagnosis,
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) -
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)) AS Age
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RBC < 4.0
);

WITH ref_date AS (

),
patients AS (
  SELECT p.ID,
         p.Admission,
         p.Birthday,
         CAST((julianday(r.max_d) - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age
  FROM Patient p
  CROSS JOIN ref_date r
  WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
)
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID,
       p.Admission
FROM patients p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.age >= 50

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX
FROM Patient P

WITH sle_patients AS (

normal_hgb_patients AS (

SELECT sp.ID, sp.SEX
FROM sle_patients sp
JOIN normal_hgb_patients nh ON sp.ID = nh.ID
ORDER BY (julianday(date('now')) - julianday(sp.Birthday)) / 365.25 DESC

WITH abnormal_hct AS (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HCT > 50
    GROUP BY ID

SELECT AVG(l.HCT) AS average_hematocrit
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.Date) = '1991'
  AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL
  AND l.HCT < CASE
      WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 40
      WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 36
      ELSE 35
  END;

WITH latest_lab AS (
    SELECT ID, PLT
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE (ID, Date) IN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date)
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    )
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 450 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal_count,
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 450 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'More patients with lower than normal platelet count'
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 450 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
            THEN 'More patients with higher than normal platelet count'
        ELSE 'Equal number of patients with lower and higher than normal platelet count'
    END AS comparison
FROM latest_lab
WHERE PLT IS NOT NULL
  AND (PLT < 150 OR PLT > 450);

WITH czk_customers AS (

customer_avg_2013 AS (

    FROM czk_customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
min_per_segment AS (

           MIN(avg_consumption) AS min_avg_consumption
    FROM customer_avg_2013

)
SELECT 'SME - LAM' AS segment_pair,
       (sme.min_avg_consumption - lam.min_avg_consumption) AS difference
FROM min_per_segment sme
JOIN min_per_segment lam ON lam.Segment = 'LAM'
WHERE sme.Segment = 'SME'

UNION ALL

       (lam.min_avg_consumption - kam.min_avg_consumption)
FROM min_per_segment lam
JOIN min_per_segment kam ON kam.Segment = 'KAM'
WHERE lam.Segment = 'LAM'

UNION ALL

SELECT 'KAM - SME',

WITH eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        CAST(substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, Year
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = 2012 THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Cons2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = 2013 THEN TotalConsumption END) AS Cons2013
    FROM eur_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (Cons2013 - Cons2012) * 100.0 / Cons2012 AS PctIncrease
    FROM pivot
    WHERE Cons2012 > 0
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PctIncrease, 'biggest' AS Type
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY PctIncrease DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT Segment, PctIncrease, 'lowest' AS Type
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY PctIncrease ASC
    LIMIT 1
);
