FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '16:25:00';

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23' AND t.Time = '21:20:00';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
  AND date(t.Date) = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time < '12:00:00';

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date = (SELECT MIN(Date) FROM yearmonth)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Time = '12:42:00';

WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-24' AND Price = 124.05
)
SELECT 
    t.Date,
    t.Price AS expenses,
    SUM(t.Price) OVER () AS total_january_spend
FROM transactions_1k t
WHERE t.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM target_customer)
  AND t.Date >= '2012-01-01'
  AND t.Date <= '2012-01-31'
ORDER BY t.Date;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26'
  AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
  AND g.Country = 'CZE';

SELECT c.Currency
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', t.Date) = '2013-06'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Currency
HAVING SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) = 214582.17;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.TransactionID = 667467;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4;

SELECT 
  ROUND(
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN t.CustomerID END) * 100.0 / 
    NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID), 0), 2
  ) AS percentage
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25';

WITH tc AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE strftime('%Y-%m-%d', Date) = '2012-08-25'
      AND Amount * Price = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
),
c12 AS (
    SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS cons_2012
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM tc)
      AND substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
),
c13 AS (
    SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS cons_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM tc)
      AND substr(Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
)
SELECT (c12.cons_2012 - c13.cons_2013) / c12.cons_2012 AS decrease_rate
FROM c12, c13;

SELECT g.GasStationID, SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS Revenue
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN gasstations AS g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
GROUP BY g.GasStationID
ORDER BY Revenue DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS premium_percentage
FROM gasstations
WHERE Country = 'SVK';

SELECT
    SUM(Amount * Price) AS total_spent,
    SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y-%m', Date) = '2012-01' THEN Amount * Price ELSE 0 END) AS jan_2012_spent
FROM transactions_1k
WHERE CustomerID = 38508;

SELECT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductID, p.Description
ORDER BY SUM(t.Amount) DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH customer_spend AS (
    SELECT
        t.CustomerID,
        SUM(t.Amount * t.Price) AS total_spend,
        SUM(t.Amount) AS total_items
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, total_spend, total_items
    FROM customer_spend
    ORDER BY total_spend DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    c.CustomerID,
    c.Currency,
    tc.total_spend / tc.total_items AS average_price_per_item
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = tc.CustomerID;

SELECT g.Country
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.ProductID = 2
  AND t.Amount = 1
ORDER BY t.Price DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH high_price_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE ProductID = 5
      AND Price > 29.00
)
SELECT ym.CustomerID,
       ym.Consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN high_price_customers hpc ON ym.CustomerID = hpc.CustomerID
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', ym.Date) = '2012-08';
